noise_filter.algorithm_description: A frequency bin is 'stationary' iff its temporal 10th percentile (the bin's noise floor) sits more than contrast_db above the spectrum-wide reference floor (median across bins of bin_floor_db). Implemented in scripts/apply_stationary_band_filter.py find_stationary_bands().
noise_filter.rationale: Lab rig has chronic but quantitatively modest tonal noise lines (~3 dB above reference floor on validation chunks). Algorithm v1 used a global-median reference and required >+6 dB across >50% of frames; on chunk 194 the visible 65 kHz line was only +1.6 dB above global median and active 14.6% of frames, so v1 flagged 0 bands. v2 with contrast_db=3.0 catches the visible noise lines while leaving real-USV chunks effectively untouched.
